finalText:
I allocated the new dock and monitor stock, gave every other waiting line a promise date, and sent one notice to each customer I worked, except the risk-hold order. One thing to check: PO-91 (4 docks) was received partway through my run, which the task didn't mention.

**Dates and priority.** The system date reads 2026-07-25, so I used that as today. Policy update PU-12 applies, so orders placed 14 or more days ago (on or before 07-11) go first, oldest first. PU-9 expired on 06-30 and has no effect.

**PO-91.** I allocated its 4 docks down the same priority list. Without that, the 4 docks would have sat in stock while those customers waited.

**Allocated, in priority order:**
- **P-DOC:**
  - O-5201 L1 (2 docks)
  - O-5202 L2 (1)
  - O-5204 L1 (2)
  - O-5207 L1 (1)
  - O-5210 L1 (1)
  - O-5209 L1 (2)
  - O-5211 L1 (1)
  - O-5215 L1 (1)
- **P-MON:**
  - O-5202 L1 (1 monitor)
  - O-5203 L1 (2)
  - O-5207 L2 (1)
- **O-5207:** ship-complete, and both its lines could be allocated together.

**Left waiting, with promise dates:**

| Line | Promise date | Supplier PO |
|---|---|---|
| O-5206 L1 (dock) | 2026-08-14 | PO-95 |
| O-5206 L2 (hub) | 2026-08-14 | PO-90 (arrives 08-06) |
| O-5208 L1 (2 monitors) | 2026-08-05 | PO-93 |
| O-5212 L1 (monitor) | 2026-08-05 | PO-93 |
| O-5213 L1 (2 docks) | 2026-08-14 | PO-95 |
| O-5214 L1 (monitor) | 2026-08-19 | PO-97 |

- **O-5206:** it is ship-complete, so both lines take the latest of their dates. The hub line is a P-HUB line that isn't part of your two products, but it had to be dated with the dock line.
- **O-5206 backorder:** it was skipped for allocation because the hub is out of stock.

**Not touched:** O-5205 is on risk hold, so I did no allocation, set no promise date and sent no notice.

**Notices:** 14 sent, one per order. Each customer is told either that their items are allocated or their promised ship date.
